posts.zh:
ru-marketplace-mcp#dsh 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。面向俄罗斯十家电商平台的技能与可选 MCP 行：跨 Wildberries、Detsky Mir、Yandex Market 比价，以及各平台的搜索、商品卡与评论。安装后 13 个技能立即可用；两行 MCP 默认关闭，需将 RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR 指向本地克隆，该克隆需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1f4f75ebfece23f0dc6e.html
posts.en:
ru-marketplace-mcp#dsh is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Skills and optional MCP rows for ten Russian marketplaces: price comparison across Wildberries, Detsky Mir and Yandex Market, plus per-source search, product cards and reviews. The 13 skills load on install; both MCP rows stay disabled until RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR points at a local clone, which needs Python 3.12+ and uv.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1f4f75ebfece23f0dc6e.html
